bluf: BBC News World reported that three bridges in Kyiv were hit during a major Russian missile attack, killing five people. France 24 reported that Poland said no one was hurt after Warsaw alleged a Russian missile hit southeast Poland during an attack on Ukraine; BleepingComputer reported that Broadcom released updates for a VMware vCenter vulnerability exploited in attacks.

changes.text: Updated since previous brief: Green earthquake (Magnitude 6.4M, Depth:10km) in Southeast Of Easter Island 29/10/2026 07:49 UTC, [unknown].

cyber.text: BleepingComputer reported that Broadcom released security updates for a critical VMware vCenter Server authentication bypass vulnerability that Chinese-linked hackers had exploited in zero-day attacks since September 2026. The update's event time was not stated, and the report was not independently corroborated.

disasters.text: GDACS listed a magnitude 5.6 earthquake at a depth of 10 km southeast of the Loyalty Islands at 00:49 UTC on 20/11/2026. The report was not independently corroborated.

items.text: BBC News World reported that three Kyiv bridges were hit during a major Russian missile attack, killing five people; it said the strikes followed Ukraine's targeting of the Crimean Bridge. The event time was not stated, and the report was not independently corroborated.

France 24 reported that Poland said no one was hurt after Warsaw alleged a Russian missile hit southeast Poland during an attack on Ukraine. Polish authorities were investigating reports that at least two unknown objects had fallen near the border with Ukraine. The event time was not stated, and the report was not independently corroborated.

BBC News World reported that Putin vowed a “far more painful” response to Ukraine's strikes on the Crimean Bridge, which suffered major damage following a combined attack by Ukraine earlier that week. The event time was not stated, and the report was not independently corroborated.

Deutsche Welle reported that Sean Cairncross was leaving the national cyber director role after a week of tech outages and that Kirsten Davies would assume it in an acting capacity. BBC News World reported that CBS said Cairncross had been fired after losing the confidence of White House chief of staff Stephen Miller. The event time was not stated.
